guidance: To update content, call update_theme_content with a partial settings hash containing only the sections/keys you want to change. Unchanged sections are preserved automatically via deep merge. Schema defaults are NOT copied onto each section: a single top-level `_defaults` map carries them, emitted once per type. Section defaults are keyed by the section type; block defaults are keyed `"<section type>/<block type>"` (block types are only unique within a section, so the parent section type disambiguates them). Each section's own `settings` hash holds only its explicit user choices. To read an effective value, check the section's or block's own `settings.<key>` first; if the key isn't there, fall back to `_defaults.<section type>.<key>` for a section, or `_defaults["<section type>/<block type>"].<key>` for a block. When writing back via update_theme_content, omit the `_defaults` map — it is response-only metadata and is stripped on write so defaults aren't accidentally pinned as explicit choices (which would break theme version upgrades that change defaults). To make a default an explicit choice (e.g. lock `image_width` at its current default), copy the key from the matching `_defaults` entry into that section's (or block's) `settings` in your update payload.
